text:
Ellen R: FYI customer baz-co reported invoice preview showing ~25% higher token usage than final for yesterday 21:00-21:15 UTC.
Tom S: Any deploys or edge rotations around that time?
Ellen R: Ops did a rolling restart on the edge pool to pick up a kernel patch at 20:58.
Yuki N: That often causes short-lived connection churn. Our preview pipeline dedupes on session_fingerprint which includes connection_id. Ledger dedupe runs later on req_id. If connection_id flips we can double-count in preview.
Tom S: Can we patch preview to also consult req_id before emitting preview events? Might be heavy.
Yuki N: Option: compute a lightweight fallback hash when req_id missing or connection_id flagged as generated. Hash = model+first_64_tokens+tenant_id. Only compute for ~0.5% of traffic where headers look unstable.
Ellen R: Good. Also please add a console note and a short support playbook: "If preview > final, check recent edge restarts and whether generated-client headers spiked."
billing-bot: alert: preview_delta_pct{tenant="baz-co"} = 24.7
Tom S: Short-term: Ops will avoid more restarts on that pool for 2 hours. Mid-term: deploy canary of preview-dedupe-v1 that prefers req_id, then payload_hash. Feature-flagged to 1% tenants first.
Yuki N: I'll open PR and add telemetry counter events.with_generated_client_id so we can measure how often we hit the fallback.
Ellen R: I'll open INC-4120 and notify CS. Also schedule a quick retro after canary.
Tom S: Thanks. Keep the alert muted for baz-co until we flip the flag.
Ellen R: Noted.
